main.name: Damian Domżalski
main.description: Engineering data intelligence at Measure Studio. Building AI products — FirstVibe.app & FlashFeed.club.
main.bio: I'm a software engineer with 9 years of experience, rooted in the Ruby on Rails ecosystem and now working at the intersection of data and product. At Measure Studio I build the data pipelines and application features behind social media intelligence for major brands. Before that I worked as a Rails developer and team leader at Netguru. On the side I build and launch my own products — FirstVibe.app, FlashFeed.club, Elzora.pl and ZgadajmySie.co. My entire career has been remote, so I'm a proven remote teammate — and I still enjoy the occasional in-person sprint. Off the keyboard: swimming, basketball and martial arts.

projects.title: Measure Studio
projects.description: Social media data intelligence platform trusted by top brands and agencies. I build data pipelines, analytics features, and the core application powering millions of data points daily.

projects.title: FirstVibe.app
projects.description: Upload a selfie, get your honest vibe score in 30 seconds. AI selfie analysis with 122K+ analyses across 144+ countries — built from zero to launch.

projects.title: FlashFeed.club
projects.description: AI summarizes the news, you swipe through the headlines. A bilingual news aggregator with card-based UX, 9 categories, emoji reactions, and personalized feeds.
